motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Interactive control color, border, and lift changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear action for a workflow step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; background:#1559d6; color:#fff; font:700 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#0e46ae; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1559d6; outline-offset:2px; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #b9d3ff; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid #aeb9c9; border-radius:8px; background:#fffefa; color:#15223a; font:700 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color:#1559d6; color:#1559d6; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1559d6; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled field in an editing workflow.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#15223a; font:650 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { padding:8px; border:1px solid #aeb9c9; border-radius:8px; background:#fffefa; color:#15223a; font:400 16px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1559d6; outline-offset:2px; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #b9d3ff; }

components.name: Record Details
components.description: A stable table for concise record facts.
components.css: .ds-record { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #d9dfe8; border-radius:12px; background:#fffefa; color:#15223a; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-record > strong { display:block; padding:16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid #d9dfe8; } .ds-record dl { margin:0; } .ds-record dl div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.7fr 1.3fr; gap:16px; padding:12px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid #d9dfe8; } .ds-record dl div:last-child { border:0; } .ds-record dt { color:#5a687c; font-size:14px; font-weight:650; } .ds-record dd { margin:0; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet workspace navigation with a clear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:block; padding:11px 12px; border-radius:8px; color:#5a687c; font:650 16px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#eaf1ff; color:#1559d6; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1559d6; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: A calm, practical workspace where candidates can organise and refine their career evidence without feeling like they are operating developer tooling.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white canvas with deep navy ink and a single cobalt action color.
Georgia display headings paired with a neutral system sans.
Structured records and live previews make dense information easy to scan.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is reserved for action, selection, links, and focus.

dos: Do use warm surfaces and precise hairlines to group information before shadows.
Do make editing explicit with labelled fields, a review action, and a live preview.
donts: Don't use the old Vercel aesthetic, mesh gradients, technical eyebrows, or marketing pills.
Don't let record facts float as ungrouped label/value text.
